A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Provispo B.V.

Club pays for a coaching tool

Provispo B.V.Premium

Terneuzen, Netherlands · founded 2010 · active · provispo.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolFixed multi-lensNo Italian presence foundEvidence CQuote onlyOne registered employee (KvK)

A small Dutch integrator that installs fixed dual-camera panoramic and PTZ systems at professional training grounds, runs them from its PlayStats cloud, and has added a portable on-device 180-degree camera called SportCam Go for lower budgets.

For Professional academies and federation training centres in the Benelux and Portugal that want owned camera infrastructure across several pitches, open export to Hudl, Sportscode or Nacsport, and RTSP feeds for live analysis. The SportCam Go targets amateur clubs and single-team analysts who want the same openness without the install.

Provispo exists because Dutch and Belgian academies wanted cameras that behaved like infrastructure they owned, with scheduled recording, local storage and plain MP4 downloads, with no closed subscription platform in the way, and a one-person Terneuzen company built that for Feyenoord, AZ, Genk and Royal Antwerp provispo-01, provispo-03, provispo-09. It matters now because the SportCam Go, with onboard processing, RTSP access and a 10-hour battery, takes that analyst-first, open-export philosophy into the portable segment where Veo and Pixellot sell closed clouds provispo-02, provispo-08. It tells you that the fight in this space is shifting from who has the best AI camera operator to who lets the club keep control of the footage and the workflow.

Price band No prices published; all systems including SportCam Go are quoted after consultation provispo-02

Italy No Italian client, reseller or office appears on the vendor site, in its news or in the company record, and the stated federation work covers the Netherlands, Belgium and Portugal provispo-01, provispo-03.

The verdict

Look if You are an academy or federation with several pitches, an analyst on staff, existing Hudl, Sportscode, Nacsport or Dartfish licences, and a preference for owned hardware with open MP4 and RTSP access over a closed subscription cloud. Look at SportCam Go if you want a portable panoramic camera that processes on the device and can be used for live analysis without waiting for a cloud upload.

Skip if You want published pricing, a large support organisation or a fan-facing streaming platform with paywall and sponsor tools, none of which Provispo offers. Skip also if you sit outside the Benelux and Portugal and need local installation and service, because the company is registered with one employee and has no stated presence elsewhere.

Watch-outs

  • Provispo B.V. is registered with one employee at a Terneuzen address under RvL Holding B.V., so delivery depends on a very small team and its partners provispo-09, provispo-10.
  • No price for any product, including SportCam Go, is published, and every enquiry goes through a WhatsApp or consultation route provispo-02, provispo-01.
  • The SportCam Go page gives battery life, storage and field of view and omits resolution, weight, frame rate and tripod details provispo-02.
  • Client and federation claims such as Feyenoord, AZ, Royal Antwerp, KRC Genk, the Belgian and Portuguese federations and the KNVB are stated by the vendor and could not be confirmed from the clubs' or federations' own channels provispo-01, provispo-03.
  • The public news page carries a single item from October 2024, and the blog restarted in February 2026 with one comparison post and one password-protected Q&A, so public evidence of momentum is thin provispo-07, provispo-11.
  • Livestreaming targets analysis tools and platforms such as Eyecons, YouTube, SportRecs and Vimeo, and there is no Provispo-owned OTT, paywall or sponsor overlay layer provispo-05.

Products

  • SportCam Go (camera). Portable AI football camera with 180-degree panorama, auto-follow and tactical feeds, on-device processing, RTSP access, 64 GB storage and 10-hour battery. provispo-02
  • SportCam Automatic (camera). Fixed two-camera panoramic system with tracking-driven pan, tilt and zoom, tactical view and fixed PTZ view for training zones. provispo-04
  • SportCam Goal, Side, Control and Drone (camera). Bird's-eye half-pitch camera, 4K sideline camera, joystick-controlled PTZ and compact 4K HDR drone for additional angles. provispo-01
  • SportCam Recorder (platform). On-site recorder workstation that calibrates cameras, stores source video locally, outputs RTSP and RTMP and uploads to PlayStats, Dotcomsport, Hudl or Soccerlab. provispo-06
  • PlayStats Platform (platform). Cloud platform for camera management, scheduling, live viewing, tagging, clips, XML, CSV and JSON import and MP4 download. provispo-05

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
The fixed SportCam Automatic pairs two cameras to record a full pitch in panoramic view with a tactical view and a fixed PTZ view for training zones, managed from PlayStats with scheduled recording and live tagging, and it is aimed at professional academies with named clients such as Royal Antwerp, Feyenoord, KRC Genk, Dinamo Zagreb, AZ Alkmaar and Excelsior provispo-04, provispo-01. SportCam Go extends the range to amateur clubs and single analysts with a portable 180-degree camera and an optional event data service provispo-02. Football is the stated core, with the site also listing golf, baseball, American football and combat sports features on third-party directories provispo-12.
Capture quality
The vendor states 4K Ultra HD at up to 60 fps for its camera range, with the SportCam Side and SportCam Drone listed as 4K devices and the Goal camera giving a bird's-eye half-pitch view provispo-01. SportCam Go's resolution is not stated on its page, which gives only the 180-degree panoramic field of view, dual auto-follow and tactical feeds, 64 GB onboard storage and a 10-hour battery provispo-02. No sample footage specifications or independent tests are public.
Automation accuracy
Recording on the fixed system is driven by player and ball tracking with automated pan, tilt and zoom, and the software selects the tactical view automatically provispo-04. SportCam Go adds AI auto tracking that can be switched to manual control to focus on players or zones provispo-02. Provispo publishes no accuracy figures and there is no independent evaluation, so this is not assessable beyond vendor description.
Multi-angle and stitching
The SportCam Recorder calibrates two side cameras capturing left and right halves of the pitch and uses that calibration for distance, position and speed measurements, then generates a combined output during recording provispo-06. Clubs can add Goal, Side, Control and Drone cameras under the same PlayStats management for multi-angle coverage provispo-01, provispo-05. SportCam Go stitches on the device into a single panorama with a separate auto-follow feed provispo-02.
Latency and live readiness
Live video from each SportCam is viewable in PlayStats during recording, RTSP and RTMP streams can be pushed straight into analysis suites, and SportCam Go offers RTSP and direct device access so analysis can start during the match without cloud processing provispo-05, provispo-06, provispo-02. Fan streaming goes to third-party platforms such as Eyecons, YouTube, SportRecs and Vimeo provispo-05. No latency figures are published.
Reliability and resilience
The fixed system stores source video on the local disk of a PC workstation in a dedicated directory, which protects recordings from upload failures, and the cameras are described as weatherproof set-and-forget hardware provispo-06, provispo-01. SportCam Go records to 64 GB onboard storage on a 10-hour battery provispo-02. There are no public reliability reviews, app store ratings or uptime statements, so field reliability is not assessable from public sources.
Portability and install
The core product is a permanent installation with two side cameras, a recorder workstation and optional additional cameras, which implies cabling and mounting at each pitch provispo-06, provispo-04. SportCam Go is placed beside the pitch and started with one button, with no tripod height or weight given provispo-02. Installation is presumably carried out by Provispo or partners in the Benelux, though the site does not say who installs.
Connectivity and bandwidth
The fixed system records locally and uploads to PlayStats during or after the match, with Dotcomsport, Hudl and Soccerlab upload options integrated, so bandwidth needs are deferred to after the match provispo-06. SportCam Go processes on the device and offers RTSP over the local network, which means it works without an internet uplink at the pitch provispo-02. No minimum upload speeds are published.
Workflow and UX
PlayStats handles camera management, scheduling from a mobile device, live viewing, real-time tagging with custom panels and shortcuts, clips and playlists, a zoomable player and MP4 download, and it imports XML, CSV and JSON event data from other providers to sync with video provispo-05, provispo-04. The workflow is built around an analyst at a desk. No app store listing was found for a Provispo mobile app.
Analysis layer
Provispo offers tagging, clips, playlists and import of third-party event data, plus an optional event data service on SportCam Go where clubs can have match events created for them provispo-05, provispo-02. The recorder's calibration supports distance, position and speed measurement from video provispo-06. There is no published metrics catalogue, no xG or physical reports and no API, so the analysis layer is a workflow tool that hands off to Hudl, Sportscode, Nacsport, Dartfish, MyVA or Longomatch provispo-04, provispo-01.
Integrations
Exports are plain MP4 for Nacsport, MyVA, Longomatch and Dartfish, uploads are integrated with Dotcomsport, Hudl and Soccerlab, live feeds go out over RTSP and RTMP, and PlayStats imports XML, CSV and JSON provispo-04, provispo-06, provispo-05. Openness to third-party tools is the company's stated positioning in its February 2026 comparison post provispo-08. This is the broadest documented integration set among the small European vendors.
Distribution and OTT
Livestreams can be sent to Eyecons, YouTube, SportRecs, Vimeo and similar platforms for fan engagement, and that is the extent of distribution provispo-05. There is no Provispo viewer app, paywall, sponsor banner tool or highlight publishing product. Clubs wanting monetised streaming need a separate platform.
Data access and ownership
Source video sits on the club's own workstation for the fixed system, all recordings are also stored in the PlayStats cloud with preview and download, and SportCam Go keeps footage on the device with direct access provispo-06, provispo-05, provispo-02. No terms of service, privacy policy or data licence could be found on the public site, so ownership and reuse rights are undocumented in public. The architecture favours the club, the paperwork is invisible.
Privacy and compliance
No privacy policy, consent guidance, blurring feature or data processing terms are published on the site, and the only privacy-related feature is offline, on-device processing on SportCam Go provispo-02. For a Dutch B.V. serving academies with minors this is a documentation gap, and practice may be better. Not assessable from public sources.
Security
Not assessable from public sources. The site documents no hosting region, certification or access control for PlayStats.
Pricing and TCO
No price is published for any camera, the recorder, PlayStats or SportCam Go, and the site routes every enquiry to a consultation, a WhatsApp chat or a gated white paper provispo-02, provispo-01. A fixed dual-camera install with a workstation and cloud platform will sit in professional academy budgets; SportCam Go is positioned for amateur clubs, which implies a price below the fixed system, and nothing more can be said without a quote. Total cost therefore cannot be modelled from public material.
Support and service
Support is offered through email, a Dutch mobile number and WhatsApp with a claim of 24/7 availability and replies within minutes, and the named team is three people: CEO Remco van Leeuwen, sales manager Marc Verwei and operational manager Dennis de Kraker provispo-01, provispo-03. The company record shows one employee, so the wider team likely works through the holding or as contractors provispo-09. No SLA is published.
Company health and roadmap
Provispo B.V. (KvK 76830462) dates from October 2010, is owned by RvL Holding B.V. since December 2019, is registered under SBI 62100 computer programming with one employee, and files no public financial detail provispo-09, provispo-10. Public activity in 2025 and 2026 consists of the SportCam Go launch, a February 2026 comparison post and a protected Q&A on an AI-powered Goal camera, plus the FC Twente injury research partnership from October 2024 provispo-02, provispo-11, provispo-07. The company claims more than a decade of operation and 100 intelligent systems deployed provispo-03.
Evidence and references
Vendor-stated references include Royal Antwerp, Feyenoord, KRC Genk, Standard Liège, Dinamo Zagreb, AZ Alkmaar, Excelsior Rotterdam, FC Twente and the Dutch, Belgian and Portuguese federations, with headline numbers of 3 or more federations, 95 or more clubs (45 professional, 50 amateur), 100 systems and 10,000 or more matches captured provispo-01, provispo-03. The FC Twente research collaboration with Demcon Johan Sports and the University of Twente is the one dated, named partnership announcement provispo-07. None of the club or federation references could be confirmed from the counterparties' own channels.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
No independent reviews, app store ratings or case study quotes from analysts are public, and the SourceForge listing shows zero reviews provispo-12. Not assessable from public sources.
Edge versus cloud
The fixed system is edge first, recording to a local workstation and syncing to PlayStats later, and SportCam Go processes entirely on the device with RTSP access and no cloud dependency, which the vendor presents as a deliberate contrast with cloud-processing competitors provispo-06, provispo-02. PlayStats is the cloud layer for storage, tagging and sharing provispo-05. This is the most edge-oriented architecture in this group.
Accessibility and languages
The website is in English with Dutch-language contact details, and the company operates in the Netherlands, Belgium and Portugal provispo-01, provispo-03. No Italian, French or German interface or support is documented.
Upgrade path
A club can start with SportCam Go, move to a fixed SportCam Automatic install, and add Goal, Side, Control and Drone cameras under one PlayStats account, with an AI-powered Goal camera previewed in a February 2026 Q&A provispo-01, provispo-11. Because exports are MP4 and RTSP, the upgrade path does not lock the club into Provispo's platform. No firmware or roadmap communication is public.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the RTSP feed from SportCam Go into your existing analysis suite on the bench and measure how quickly you can start tagging during the first half provispo-02. Test the MP4 download and XML import round trip with your current provider's event data in PlayStats provispo-05. Ask for a written price, a written data licence and the names of two academy clients you can call, since none of the three exists in public.

(established December 2019), with trade names including Ipeo, Limeworkx and PanoField, and led by CEO Remco van Leeuwen provispo-09, provispo-10, provispo-03. No external funding is public.

Financials Not public. Registry summaries show one employee and no filed turnover or profit detail provispo-09, provispo-10.

Scale, company-stated Vendor-stated as of September 2026: more than a decade of operation, 100 intelligent systems deployed, 3 or more federations, 95 or more clubs of which 45 professional and 50 amateur, and 10,000 or more matches captured provispo-03.
